title: Technology Sector Update for 01/25/2019: AMD,CLRO,INTC,ERIC
text:

Technology stocks helped carry the broader markets higher Friday, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 adding about 1.3% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was rising more than 2.1%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Nokia ( NOK ) rose over 7% on Friday after the Canadian government pledged to provide the Finnish networking equipment company with CAD40 million, or about $30 million, to fund its research into 5G wireless technology in the country, according to media reports.
In other sector news:
(+) ClearOne ( CLRO ) surged nearly 13% on Friday after the US Patent and Trademark Office upheld the patents underlying its technology used in beam-forming microphone arrays in a patent dispute with Shure Inc.
(+) Advanced Micro Devices ( AMD ) was ahead over 5% Friday. the company said it is consolidating all of its sales operations under its new chief sales officer Darren Grasby, who had been previously responsible for worldwide sales to PC manufacturers and channel partners.
(-) Intel ( INTC ) was down more than 6% after the chip giant late Thursday reported a 9% year-over-year increase in Q4 revenue to a record $18.66 billion but still lagged the Capital IQ consensus expecting $19.02 billion in revenue for the three months ended Dec. 29.
